content.comment_body: Hello all, I can't find any clear or straightforward examples or references for EIB configuration, EST programming, or wiring. It seems like all resources are in German. Are there any useful tips or tricks for EIB?

Hi, If you use Product Support and search a bit, you can find useful resources. For example: The manual: [url], Some example projects: [url], [url]. There are many more resources available on that platform. Regards,

analysis.insight_summary: Users have difficulty finding accessible and practical materials for setting up and programming EIB and EST due to most available documentation being in German. This leads to confusion and frustration when working with these systems.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are looking for clear, beginner-friendly, and language-accessible guides and examples for EIB and EST configurations and programming, without needing to sift through German-language resources.
